findings.finding_text: Post-pin manifest row rev is never checked against the pin — contradictory provenance passes silently; row.rev is dead data in the post-pin branch while the authorship test separately enforces newest-row truth.
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Blind+acceptance converged. Fix: post-pin rows require rev === pin (named failure) + fixture.

findings.finding_text: Manifest maps 6 sc2-7 evidence JSONs still untracked on the branch — clean CI clone fails the alarm with 6 ghost rows (reproduced via git archive simulation).
findings.label: HIGH
findings.rationale: Driver git action (planned since round-1 F-009): stage the 6 evidence JSONs unedited with the branch commit.

findings.finding_text: Date.parse rollover accepts impossible calendar dates (2026-02-30 → Mar 2) for pinnedAt and citing.timestamp — brackets shift by days.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Blind+edge converged. Fix: roundtrip check (parse → toISOString === input) replaces NaN-only.

findings.finding_text: Writer stamp-ownership guard is top-level-only while the alarm's finder is fully recursive — a nested caller stamp lands on disk and fires false drift.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Blind+edge converged. Fix: deep-scan guard in writeEvidence matching the alarm's read depth.

findings.finding_text: Two stampedDirs sharing a relative file key cross-validate each other's rows; dir B's absence silently covered by dir A's row.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Latent until Z3 (single dir today). Fix: stampedDirs.length > 1 → loud failure demanding a deliberate dir-qualified manifest-format extension (contract text wins; Z3 lands it).

findings.finding_text: Status-vocabulary pin is one-directional containment — vocabulary-list rot cannot fail CI; docblock claims more than enforced.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Fix: length===16 assertion + docblock honesty note (wire-side new word fails by name; list-vs-docblock rot is review-enforced — src is read-only here).

findings.finding_text: INV-Z1-2 test name still over-claims: 'every other verb outside this contract' reads as proven exclusion; body asserts two-verb presence only.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Rename to exactly what is proven; name Z2's allowlist as the real fence.

findings.finding_text: Alarm fatigue: automatic stamping + hand-curated rows = routine red steady state.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Third raise of round-1 F-023: story AC6 mandates the coverage finding; DD-29 records the no-adopter-script decision + revisit trigger. Re-litigating a spec-mandated design.

findings.finding_text: q1 observe tests pairwise identical invocations on shared store.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: Third raise of F-026/F-027: premise re-verified twice (beforeEach-fresh store; acceptance r2 re-verified at q1-contract.test.ts:54-57); one helper sweep per verb, four named properties, 15/0 green.

findings.finding_text: Writer stamps the current pin regardless of the fork rev the round actually ran against — staleness enforcement relocated, but the harness comment frames laundering as solved.
findings.label: MED
findings.rationale: With R2-01 landed, a post-pin round against a newer fork forces the bump via row-rev===pin — the system self-corrects. Fix: one honest comment line naming the stale-stamp window.

findings.finding_text: Unstamped-row garbage timestamps feed the authorship test's newest-row computation for AC4's equality target.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Test-side: validate every real-manifest row timestamp (ISO-Z + roundtrip) before the newest computation; malformed → named failure.

findings.finding_text: F-012 lint matches the stamp literal inside comments too — a commented-out stamp passes.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Strip // and /* */ comments from the harness source before body extraction and matching.

findings.finding_text: writeEvidence's new guards (non-object throw, caller-stamp throw) have no coverage — first contact would be a live E2E failure.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Extend the F-012 source-lint to assert the two guard throws exist in the writeEvidence body (behavioral test impossible without corpus pollution — QDS_ROOT is not injectable).

findings.finding_text: Null payload error renders 'got object' (typeof null).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: One line: name null explicitly.

findings.finding_text: F-004's citing-instant guard has no enforcing test — fx-alarm's coverage claim was wrong (bad-pinnedAt returns before rows are read).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Fixture: shape-valid impossible citing.timestamp asserting the single named failure (with R2-03's roundtrip check).

findings.finding_text: Manifest JSON parsing to null throws TypeError instead of the structured one-line failure.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Guard typeof/manifest===null → fold into the malformed-manifest failure path.

findings.finding_text: stampedDirs empty or duplicate entries never validated — empty yields vacuous green, dupes double every line.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Empty → failure ('no stamped dirs'); duplicates → failure naming the repeated entry.

findings.finding_text: evidenceDir existing as a regular file: statSync ENOTDIR swallowed into the missing-subdir path, hiding the real cause.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: statSync + isDirectory check → throw naming the path type problem.

findings.finding_text: Top-level evidence file coincidentally named fork-rev-manifest.json while manifestPath points elsewhere is silently unwalked.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Exclude only when the walked path resolves equal to manifestPath.

findings.finding_text: Round subdir reachable only through a symlink is never walked (isDirectory false for the link) — silent unstamped gap.
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Fail loud on symlinked evidence paths ('flatten the corpus') rather than follow (loop risk) — conservative alarm doctrine.

findings.finding_text: A missing stamped dir turns F-009 into 1+N spam (every row under it ghosts).
findings.label: LOW
findings.rationale: Rows under a known-missing stamped dir are excluded from the ghost check (the missing-dir failure is the root cause line).
